safetyReasoning: Each case starts in a fresh nonpersistent browser context without reused authenticated storage, and enters the explicit admin/parent demo button.
App demo banner is asserted before booking. Reviewed ApiService.createReservation uses localStorage when session.mode is demo; live service actions use POST, which the route aborts.
Service workers are blocked and WebSockets are closed. Current before-final evidence has no blocked mutation attempts, socket attempts, or page errors.
GET/HEAD allowance is not a general guarantee against arbitrary future GET-side effects. The no-live-ledger-write conclusion is scoped to this reviewed published application and its demo branch.
